title: Port exp_0004 anchor-bias to epoch-2 question-only tone config
hypothesis: On top of exp_0011's question-only register decoupling (or exp_0009 if exp_0011 regresses), add exp_0004's validated soft PASS-1 bias to prefer source facts already carrying a concrete anchor (number/medication/timeframe/percentage), all-else-equal, leaving answer composition and QA_PER_SOURCE=8 untouched.
technique: Prompt edit in GEN_SYSTEM_PROMPT PASS-1 only: one soft preference clause for anchor-bearing facts (exp_0004's exact wording, which produced +0.0137 over exp_0000 in epoch 1); no restructure of the extraction instruction (rag_q_10 canary lesson), QA_PER_SOURCE=8, RAG params unchanged.
data_source: datasets/ QuitTxt human-KB source chunks (fixed, seeded 5-chunk sample)
rationale: exp_0004 is the largest committed positive delta in the run (+0.0137) and its specificity channel (0.20 weight) has never been re-applied in epoch 2, where specificity dipped to ~0.66 under exp_0009. The anchor-bias is a fact-SELECTION lever, orthogonal to the question-register lever exp_0011 concentrates on, so the two should stack the same way they did in exp_0004's dual-channel design.
differentiation_from_existing: Epoch-2 experiments so far only varied tone mechanism (exp_0006/0009/0011) or extraction breadth (exp_0007/0008/0010). None re-applied the epoch-1-validated anchor preference; breadth failures rewrote/expanded WHAT gets extracted, this only tie-breaks WHICH equally-eligible fact wins a slot.

title: Retrieval headroom: RAG_TOP_K 3 -> 5, generation prompt frozen
hypothesis: Keeping the best committed generation config unchanged, raise RAG_TOP_K from 3 to 5 to remove the embedding-displacement bottleneck that has capped or killed at least three experiments (exp_0002 40->50 pair displacement, exp_0006 warm-opener dilution flipping rag_q_01/10/16, exp_0009 attempt-level flips on rag_q_01/05/10/16).
technique: Single-constant change in data_gen_experiment.py: RAG_TOP_K=5. GEN_SYSTEM_PROMPT, QA_PER_SOURCE, RAG_TEMPLATE all frozen at the exp_0009 (or exp_0011-winner) values so the delta is attributable to retrieval width alone.
data_source: datasets/ QuitTxt human-KB source chunks (fixed, seeded 5-chunk sample)
expected_score_uplift: +0.01-0.03 absolute composite (each recovered refusal is +0.05 faith = +0.02 composite; 3-4 flip-prone questions in play)
rationale: Faithfulness carries 0.40 weight and 10/20 rag questions are persistent refusals; the flip-prone subset (rag_q_01/05/10/16) is repeatedly attributed to top_k=3 crowding rather than source absence. RAG_TOP_K is explicitly agent-changeable per project.md, and unlike RAG_TEMPLATE wording tricks it applies symmetrically to both arms without instructing verbatim copying. Caution to carry into the hypothesis: exp_0003's discard note disputed displacement in the count-isolated case, and the human-baseline arm must be checked to move in lockstep (Goodhart check #2); note also that wider context is expected to lift the human arm too, so relative_pct may not improve even if the composite does.
differentiation_from_existing: No experiment in the graph has varied any retrieval-side parameter; all 11 experiments edited the generation prompt or pair count. This also unblocks the entire breadth direction (exp_0007/0008/0010 family) by relaxing the zero-sum slot constraint they died on.

title: Retest gentle-append breadth under widened retrieval (top_k=5)
hypothesis: If the RAG_TOP_K=5 experiment confirms displacement was real (flip-prone questions recover), retest exp_0010's gentle-append practical/behavioral breadth (original headline extraction sentence verbatim + one appended inclusion nudge, QA_PER_SOURCE=10) with RAG_TOP_K=5, since the breadth family's refusal-conversion gains were plausibly eaten by displacement under top_k=3.
technique: Combine exp_0010's PASS-1 gentle-append line (verbatim) + QA_PER_SOURCE=10 with RAG_TOP_K=5; question-register instruction from the current best committed node. Canaries: rag_q_10 (definitional) must hold; watch qa_pair quality dims for the [:15] sampling-fraction gaming pattern flagged in project.md since pair count rises to 50.
data_source: datasets/ QuitTxt human-KB source chunks (fixed, seeded 5-chunk sample)
expected_score_uplift: +0.02-0.05 absolute composite if displacement was the true blocker; ~0 if refusals are source-absent
rationale: Four breadth experiments (exp_0002/0003/0007/0008/0010) all showed the same signature: some refusals converted while previously-passing definitional questions flipped to 0 -- a zero-sum trade consistent with 40-50 pairs competing for 3 retrieval slots. exp_0007 actually scored above its baseline (0.6397 vs 0.6363) before being pruned. Widening top_k is the one confound-removal none of them had; this is the highest-leverage retest in the graph because converting even 2 of the 10 persistent refusals is worth +0.04 composite.
differentiation_from_existing: Not a fifth breadth prompt variant: the prompt half is exp_0010 verbatim; the new factor is the retrieval width interaction, untested anywhere in the graph. Sequenced behind the top_k-only experiment so the interaction is interpretable.

title: META: refusal taxonomy audit before further breadth experiments
hypothesis: Before any more PASS-1 breadth variants are run, classify every failing rag_q (score 0 in exp_0005 baseline) as source-absent / extraction-miss / retrieval-displacement, and annotate noise-bound canaries (rag_q_10 confirmed noise-bound in exp_0010).
technique: Maintenance task, not evo new: script over the 5 sampled source chunks + generated pairs + rag_q gold answers; grep needed fact keywords in source chunks; emit per-question class; store via evo annotate. Ceiling estimate = fraction of failing rag_qs that are source-present.
expected_score_uplift: n/a (prevents repeat of 4 discarded breadth experiments; establishes attainable faith ceiling)
rationale: Four breadth experiments (exp_0002/0003/0008/0010) were discarded on the same root-cause family: many rag_q refusals target facts absent from the sampled source, so no extraction-prompt lever can convert them. Without the taxonomy, the orchestrator cannot tell which refusals are winnable.
differentiation_from_existing: Meta-work; no prior experiment measured the source-present ceiling -- all five breadth attempts assumed refusals were extraction misses.

title: RAG_TOP_K 3->5 config-only experiment to relieve retrieval displacement
hypothesis: Raising RAG_TOP_K from 3 to 5 in data_gen_experiment.py (mutable surface, gate-exempt) removes the retrieval-displacement bottleneck that regressed both the breadth cluster (exp_0002/0008/0010) and the register cluster (exp_0006), recovering flipped canaries (rag_q_01/10/16) without touching any prompt.
technique: Single-line config change: RAG_TOP_K = 5 on top of the current best committed lineage (exp_0009). No prompt changes, isolating the retrieval constraint.
data_source: existing pipeline sources; no new data
expected_score_uplift: +2-5% absolute on faith subscore if displacement hypothesis holds
rationale: Two independent failure clusters share top_k=3 displacement as the stated root cause in discard reasons. Testing the constraint directly is cheaper than the fifth prompt variant. CAVEAT for orchestrator: confirm RAG_TOP_K counts as system-under-optimization config rather than benchmark config before spending the slot -- it sits in the mutable file but changes eval retrieval conditions.
differentiation_from_existing: All prior displacement mitigations manipulated the generation prompts (count-isolation, gentle-append, fact-forward answers); none varied the retrieval budget itself.

title: META: index question-only embeddings to decouple answer register from retrieval (harness change)
hypothesis: Embedding documents as 'Q: {q}\nA: {a}' (data_gen_prepare.py:272, build_collection) is the mechanical root cause of the register cluster's displacement: any answer-register warmth shifts the pair embedding away from fact keywords. Indexing on question text only (returning full Q+A as the document payload) would make answer register retrieval-neutral and unlock the tone direction fully.
technique: Maintenance/harness proposal, NOT an evo new: data_gen_prepare.py is protected by the harness_integrity gate, so this requires an orchestrator decision (gate amendment or epoch-3 baseline re-score, like the exp_0005 refusal-scoring change). Change: embed questions only; keep documents as full pairs for context assembly.
data_source: existing pipeline sources; no new data
expected_score_uplift: n/a directly; removes the tax that cost exp_0006 -0.02 and capped exp_0009
rationale: exp_0006 proved the tone mechanism (+0.14 tone) but was discarded solely for displacement; exp_0009 recovered it only by constraining answers to fact-first, sacrificing specificity (0.687->0.66). Fixing the index removes the tradeoff at its source instead of prompting around it forever.
differentiation_from_existing: Prior fixes (exp_0009 fact-forward, pending exp_0011 question-only register) work around the Q+A embedding; none change the embedding composition itself.

title: META: measure benchmark noise floor (3x baseline replicates) before further ~0.02-delta discards
hypothesis: Discard decisions are being made on deltas of 0.01-0.03 with zero variance data; running the exp_0005 baseline benchmark 3 times (~4 min each) establishes a per-task and aggregate noise floor so the orchestrator can set a minimum detectable effect for commit/discard.
technique: Maintenance task: 3 replicate runs of the unchanged epoch-2 baseline benchmark command; compute per-task stddev; annotate tasks with stddev > 0.2 (rag_q_10 expected) as noise-bound via evo annotate; publish aggregate sigma as a note on root.
expected_score_uplift: n/a (decision-quality fix; prevents both false discards and false commits)
rationale: exp_0001 was discarded with 'combined -0.017 within noise' and exp_0002's apparent gains were 'judge-noise on refusals' -- noise is already being invoked in discard reasons but has never been measured. The epoch-2 deterministic refusal scoring reduced one noise source; the residual floor is unknown.
differentiation_from_existing: exp_0005 fixed one specific noise source (refusal judging); no experiment or maintenance task has quantified the remaining run-to-run variance.

title: Two-call union extraction: byte-identical headline pairs + separate behavioral pass
hypothesis: Run the ORIGINAL PASS-1 headline extraction prompt unchanged (guaranteeing baseline pairs byte-identical, preserving all canaries deterministically), then a SECOND independent extraction call restricted to practical/behavioral facts not already covered, and union with dedup -- converting breadth from a zero-sum rewrite into a strict superset.
technique: Pipeline change in data_gen_experiment.py: two sequential extraction calls per source (original prompt verbatim at QA_PER_SOURCE=8, plus behavioral prompt capped at 2-3 pairs with an exclusion list of already-extracted facts); dedup by fact anchor. Best paired with or after the RAG_TOP_K 3->5 proposal, since KB grows to ~50-55 pairs which reintroduces displacement at top_k=3.
data_source: existing pipeline sources; no new data
expected_score_uplift: +1-3% absolute (bounded by the source-present fraction from the taxonomy audit)
rationale: All four discarded breadth attempts modified the single extraction prompt and hoped the LLM would preserve headline behavior -- it never did (rag_q_10 flipped in three of four). Separating the calls removes the failure mode by construction instead of by instruction.
differentiation_from_existing: exp_0010's gentle-append kept the headline SENTENCE but still one call, so the LLM rebalanced its 10 picks; no prior attempt structurally isolated the headline pairs from the breadth pairs.

title: Raise RAG_TOP_K 3->5 to defuse the recurring retrieval-displacement failure
hypothesis: Increasing RAG_TOP_K from 3 to 5 (both arms, in lockstep) converts the near-miss refusals where the correct generated pair exists but ranks 4th-5th, eliminating the displacement failure mode that regressed exp_0002/exp_0006 and that exp_0009 only partially patched via prompt contortions.
technique: Config-only change in data_gen_experiment.py: RAG_TOP_K = 5 (currently 3). GEN_SYSTEM_PROMPT unchanged from best epoch-2 parent so the lever is isolated. Verify the human-baseline arm moves in lockstep per project.md template-gaming guidance; report both arms' deltas.
expected_score_uplift: +2-6% absolute composite (each converted refusal = +0.02 composite at 0.40 faith weight; 3 distinct experiments attributed 1-3 flipped questions each to top_k=3 crowding)
rationale: Three independent experiments (exp_0002, exp_0006, exp_0009) blamed regressions on needed pairs being crowded out of a fixed top_k=3, yet no experiment has ever touched RAG_TOP_K even though it is an agent-controlled param. Literature consistently finds context recall rises with k in the 3->10 range and that retrieval quality, not prompt style, dominates faithfulness. Both arms use the same k, so this is not a template-gaming vector.
differentiation_from_existing: Every prior experiment attacked displacement via the generation prompt (fact-forward answers, count isolation). None changed the retrieval depth itself. Also unblocks retried breadth/paraphrase ideas that were displacement-limited.

references_consulted.finding: Controlled biomedical RAG study: retrieval quality, not prompt style alone, is the dominant determinant of factuality; more precise/complete retrieval yields more faithful answers
NICE clinical-guidelines RAG: perfect context precision/recall at top-10 chunks, lower context recall at top-5, i.e. recall monotonically improves with k in this range
Question-based retrieval (atomic units): retrieval recall on the question index is the binding constraint on downstream RAG accuracy

title: Overgenerate-then-roundtrip-filter: 12 candidate pairs, self-verify, keep 8
hypothesis: Adding an overgeneration + roundtrip-consistency self-check stage to GEN_SYSTEM_PROMPT (draft ~12 candidate pairs per source, keep the 8 whose answer is fully entailed by the source AND whose question is answerable from the answer text alone) raises groundedness/clinical/qa-quality dims and drops the weak pairs that currently ship unfiltered.
technique: GEN_SYSTEM_PROMPT restructure only: PASS-1 extract ~12 candidate facts; PASS-2 draft 12 QA pairs; PASS-3 self-filter with two explicit checks (answer verbatim-entailed by source; question answerable from the answer alone, roundtrip-style) and emit exactly the 8 survivors. QA_PER_SOURCE stays 8 (40 total pairs) so pair count, [:15] judging fraction, and retrieval-index size are all held constant.
expected_score_uplift: +1-3% absolute composite (quality dims are 0.60 of the weight; filtering removed ~2.4x more incorrect pairs than it discarded good ones in the reference paper)
rationale: Alberti et al. show roundtrip-consistency filtering is the difference between synthetic QA that helps and synthetic QA that hurts (+7.2 EM vs unfiltered; 39% of kept vs 16% of discarded triples correct on manual inspection), and the overgenerate-then-filter variant recovers the good pairs naive filtering throws away. This run has never given the model a candidate pool to select from - every experiment redirected what the 8 slots extract, which exp_0003's discard concluded is zero-sum.
differentiation_from_existing: All prior PASS-1 experiments (exp_0002/0003/0007/0008/0010) changed WHICH facts get extracted into a fixed 8 slots. This changes the selection mechanism itself: overgenerate then quality-filter, with pair count held at baseline so it cannot recreate the displacement or judged-fraction confounds. Orthogonal to pending exp_0011 (question register).

references_consulted.finding: Roundtrip consistency filtering: keep (C,Q,A) only if re-answering Q reproduces A; 39% of kept vs 16% of discarded triples correct; filtered synthetic data gives +2.0 EM SQuAD2 / +1.8 F1 NQ over baseline, unfiltered synthetic data 'deteriorates significantly' (7.2 EM worse)
HF papers page confirms headline numbers and the overgenerate-and-rerank fix (generate 2 questions per answer, filter each independently) for filter over-pruning
WixQA enterprise benchmark: LLM-generated KB QA pairs are systematically derived then validated - validation/filtering is standard practice for synthetic enterprise QA corpora

title: Dual-register question paraphrases: same 8 facts, 2 question phrasings each (QA_PER_SOURCE=16)
hypothesis: Emitting each of the 8 extracted facts as TWO QA pairs with the same baseline-register answer but different question phrasings (one clinical/definitional, one first-person texting register) raises retrieval recall for the 20 eval questions without the coverage loss that killed prior count increases, because the added pairs are same-fact paraphrases rather than new facts competing for slots.
technique: GEN_SYSTEM_PROMPT: keep PASS-1 extraction verbatim from baseline (8 facts); PASS-2 emits 2 questions per fact - variant A definitional/keyword-dense (medication names, numbers verbatim in the question), variant B colloquial first-person texting register (the exp_0001 tone win). Answers identical across the pair twins, baseline register. QA_PER_SOURCE = 16 (80 pairs total). Interleave twins so the [:15] judged slice samples both registers.
expected_score_uplift: +2-5% absolute composite via faith recall, plus tone hold from register-B questions
rationale: Raina & Gales show multiple synthetic questions per atomic fact yield higher retrieval recall than one representation per fact, and multi-query/paraphrase literature attributes the gain to vocabulary-mismatch bridging - exactly the generated-arm failure (eval questions phrased colloquially, KB questions phrased academically). exp_0002's 40->50 displacement came from NEW facts crowding needed ones; paraphrase twins of the SAME facts cannot displace their own fact's coverage.
differentiation_from_existing: Prior QA_PER_SOURCE increases (exp_0002, exp_0007) added new facts; this holds fact coverage exactly at baseline and adds only phrasing redundancy. GOODHART FLAG for orchestrator: raising QA_PER_SOURCE shrinks the judged [:15] fraction (project.md gaming vector 3) - verify quality dims did not jump solely from the count change, and consider pairing with RAG_TOP_K=5 if twin pairs saturate top-3 slots.

references_consulted.finding: Question-Based Retrieval using Atomic Units for Enterprise RAG (Raina & Gales, 2024): decompose chunks into atomic statements, generate a SET of synthetic questions per atom; 'retrieval with atoms leads to higher recall than chunks, with further gains from synthetic questions'
Doc2Query++: topic-coverage-based document expansion with multiple generated queries per document improves dense retrieval; filtering hallucinated queries (Doc2Query--) preserves quality
Multi-phrasing works 'because different phrasing hits different vocabulary'; improved recall when the user's vocabulary is far from the corpus's
